headline: Tornado devastates a village in southern France
lead: On Monday evening, a tornado swept through the southern French department of Aude and damaged around 300 houses. According to the authorities, 41 people were injured.
seo_title: Tornado devastates village in southern France
social_title: Tornado destroys hundreds of houses in southern France – 41 injured
summary_bullets_en: A tornado struck the Aude department in southern France on Monday evening, damaging around 300 houses.
According to authorities, 41 people were injured.
